title: Primary database down, apps get connection refused
symptoms: PostgreSQL on db-primary is not responding. Connection refused to db-primary:5432 from many web servers at once, repeated every few seconds. PostgresDown alert firing together with a flood of application errors.
root_cause: The PostgreSQL process on db-primary has stopped (crash, OOM kill, full disk or host failure), so nothing is listening on port 5432.
impact: Every service that needs the database fails: payments and checkout are down for all users.
fix_steps: Check the host is up and postgres is running: systemctl status postgresql.
Read the PostgreSQL log for the crash reason (OOM, disk full, corruption).
Free disk or memory if that was the cause, then restart postgres.
If the primary cannot be recovered quickly, promote the replica and point apps at it.
Confirm apps reconnect and error rate returns to normal.
prevention: Run a hot standby with automatic failover, monitor disk and memory on the DB host, and use connection retries with backoff.
